description: The bytes a welcome listing these request-proof versions appends to its signed bytes, after every earlier part, under tag 6 (JEP-0002 rule 2, sig; JEP-0015 rule 27). Each part is a little-endian u64 length, then its bytes: the tag is the one byte 6, then the list, which is a u64 count followed by each version's length and bytes.
